# ---- german (north_german, south_german) ----

# Country scope. Can this country start the german merge? The system is on, a core culture is
# primary, the technology of the highest core tier is known, and the merge is not complete.
te_cmg_german_is_candidate = {
	te_cm_system_enabled = yes
	OR = {
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:north_german
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:south_german
	}
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_state_german ?= 2 }
}

# Country scope. Every core slot has a passing, available alternative.
te_cmg_german_core_ok = {
	var:te_cm_ok_german_north_german ?= 1
	te_cmg_german_north_german_available = yes
	var:te_cm_ok_german_south_german ?= 1
	te_cmg_german_south_german_available = yes
}

# Any scope. north_german is free for the german merge.
te_cmg_german_north_german_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. north_german (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the german merge now.
te_cmg_german_north_german_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_german_north_german ?= 1
	te_cmg_german_north_german_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_german_north_german ?= 1 }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. south_german is free for the german merge.
te_cmg_german_south_german_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. south_german (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the german merge now.
te_cmg_german_south_german_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_german_south_german ?= 1
	te_cmg_german_south_german_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_german_south_german ?= 1 }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. alemannic is free for the german merge.
te_cmg_german_alemannic_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. alemannic (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the german merge now.
te_cmg_german_alemannic_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_german_alemannic ?= 1
	te_cmg_german_alemannic_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_german_alemannic ?= 1 }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. east_german is free for the german merge.
te_cmg_german_east_german_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. east_german (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the german merge now.
te_cmg_german_east_german_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_german_east_german ?= 1
	te_cmg_german_east_german_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_german_east_german ?= 1 }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. Is the yearly census of the german merge worth running? An idle merge with a
# candidate; or a running or complete one whose starter is alive and which still has a
# part that has neither switched nor left the world (a complete merge keeps its census so
# late parts can join). An absorb merge's result never switches, so it doesn't count.
te_cmg_german_census_wanted = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_german ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_german ?= 2 }
			any_country = { te_cmg_german_is_candidate = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_german ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_german ?= 2
			}
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_german
			global_var:te_cm_starter_german = { is_country_alive = yes }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_north_german }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:north_german value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_south_german }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:south_german value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_alemannic }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:alemannic value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_east_german }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:east_german value > 0 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

	te_cm_system_enabled = yes
	OR = {
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:czech
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:slovak
	}
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_state_czechoslovak ?= 2 }
}

# Country scope. Every core slot has a passing, available alternative.
te_cmg_czechoslovak_core_ok = {
	var:te_cm_ok_czechoslovak_czech ?= 1
	te_cmg_czechoslovak_czech_available = yes
	var:te_cm_ok_czechoslovak_slovak ?= 1
	te_cmg_czechoslovak_slovak_available = yes
}

# Any scope. czech is free for the czechoslovak merge.
te_cmg_czechoslovak_czech_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. czech (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the czechoslovak merge now.
te_cmg_czechoslovak_czech_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_czechoslovak_czech ?= 1
	te_cmg_czechoslovak_czech_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_czechoslovak_czech ?= 1 }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. slovak is free for the czechoslovak merge.
te_cmg_czechoslovak_slovak_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. slovak (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the czechoslovak merge now.
te_cmg_czechoslovak_slovak_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_czechoslovak_slovak ?= 1
	te_cmg_czechoslovak_slovak_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_czechoslovak_slovak ?= 1 }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. sorb is free for the czechoslovak merge.
te_cmg_czechoslovak_sorb_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. sorb (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the czechoslovak merge now.
te_cmg_czechoslovak_sorb_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_czechoslovak_sorb ?= 1
	te_cmg_czechoslovak_sorb_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_czechoslovak_sorb ?= 1 }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. Is the yearly census of the czechoslovak merge worth running? An idle merge with a
# candidate; or a running or complete one whose starter is alive and which still has a
# part that has neither switched nor left the world (a complete merge keeps its census so
# late parts can join). An absorb merge's result never switches, so it doesn't count.
te_cmg_czechoslovak_census_wanted = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_czechoslovak ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_czechoslovak ?= 2 }
			any_country = { te_cmg_czechoslovak_is_candidate = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_czechoslovak ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_czechoslovak ?= 2
			}
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_czechoslovak
			global_var:te_cm_starter_czechoslovak = { is_country_alive = yes }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_czech }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:czech value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_slovak }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:slovak value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_sorb }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:sorb value > 0 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# ---- hungarian (hungarian, szekely) ----

# Country scope. Can this country start the hungarian merge? The system is on, a core culture is

		country_has_primary_culture = cu:hungarian
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:szekely

	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_state_hungarian ?= 2 }

	te_cmg_hungarian_hungarian_available = yes
	var:te_cm_ok_hungarian_szekely ?= 1
	te_cmg_hungarian_szekely_available = yes

	always = yes
}

	var:te_cm_ok_hungarian_hungarian ?= 1
	te_cmg_hungarian_hungarian_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_hungarian_hungarian ?= 1 }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

	always = yes
}

# Country scope. szekely (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the hungarian merge now.

	var:te_cm_ok_hungarian_szekely ?= 1
	te_cmg_hungarian_szekely_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_hungarian_szekely ?= 1 }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. Is the yearly census of the hungarian merge worth running? An idle merge with a
# candidate; or a running or complete one whose starter is alive and which still has a
# part that has neither switched nor left the world (a complete merge keeps its census so
# late parts can join). An absorb merge's result never switches, so it doesn't count.
te_cmg_hungarian_census_wanted = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_hungarian ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_hungarian ?= 2 }
			any_country = { te_cmg_hungarian_is_candidate = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_hungarian ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_hungarian ?= 2
			}
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_hungarian
			global_var:te_cm_starter_hungarian = { is_country_alive = yes }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_szekely }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:szekely value > 0 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

	always = yes
}

	var:te_cm_ok_french_catalan ?= 1
	te_cmg_french_catalan_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_french_catalan ?= 1 }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 3 }
	has_variable = te_cm_years_french_catalan
	trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_cm_years_french_catalan } var:te_cm_years_french_catalan >= te_cm_years_tier3 }
}

# Any scope. Is the yearly census of the french merge worth running? An idle merge with a
# candidate; or a running or complete one whose starter is alive and which still has a
# part that has neither switched nor left the world (a complete merge keeps its census so
# late parts can join). An absorb merge's result never switches, so it doesn't count.
te_cmg_french_census_wanted = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_french ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_french ?= 2 }
			any_country = { te_cmg_french_is_candidate = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_french ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_french ?= 2
			}
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_french
			global_var:te_cm_starter_french = { is_country_alive = yes }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_wallonian }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:wallonian value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_occitan }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:occitan value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_catalan }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:catalan value > 0 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_dixie }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:dixie value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_afro_american }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:afro_american value > 0 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# ---- anglophone (british, yankee/cm_american) ----

# Country scope. Can this country start the anglophone merge? The system is on, a core culture is
# primary, the technology of the highest core tier is known, and the merge is not complete.
te_cmg_anglophone_is_candidate = {
	te_cm_system_enabled = yes
	OR = {
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:british
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:yankee
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:cm_american
	}
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 2 }
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_state_anglophone ?= 2 }
}

# Country scope. Every core slot has a passing, available alternative.
te_cmg_anglophone_core_ok = {
	var:te_cm_ok_anglophone_british ?= 1
	te_cmg_anglophone_british_available = yes
	OR = {
		AND = {
			var:te_cm_ok_anglophone_yankee ?= 1
			te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_available = yes
		}
		AND = {
			var:te_cm_ok_anglophone_cm_american ?= 1
			te_cmg_anglophone_cm_american_available = yes
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. british is free for the anglophone merge.
te_cmg_anglophone_british_available = {
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_in_british ?= 11 }
}

# Country scope. british (tier 1b) passes its gates and can join the anglophone merge now.
te_cmg_anglophone_british_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_anglophone_british ?= 1
	te_cmg_anglophone_british_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_anglophone_british ?= 1 }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 2 }
	has_variable = te_cm_years_anglophone_british
	trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_cm_years_anglophone_british } var:te_cm_years_anglophone_british >= te_cm_years_tier2 }
}

# Any scope. yankee is free for the anglophone merge.
te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_available = {
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_in_yankee ?= 12 }
}

# Country scope. yankee (tier 1b) passes its gates and can join the anglophone merge now.
te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_anglophone_yankee ?= 1
	te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_anglophone_yankee ?= 1 }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 2 }
	has_variable = te_cm_years_anglophone_yankee
	trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_cm_years_anglophone_yankee } var:te_cm_years_anglophone_yankee >= te_cm_years_tier2 }
}

# Any scope. cm_american is free for the anglophone merge.
te_cmg_anglophone_cm_american_available = {
	global_var:te_cm_state_american ?= 2
}

# Country scope. cm_american (tier 1b) passes its gates and can join the anglophone merge now.
te_cmg_anglophone_cm_american_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_anglophone_cm_american ?= 1
	te_cmg_anglophone_cm_american_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_anglophone_cm_american ?= 1 }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 2 }
	has_variable = te_cm_years_anglophone_cm_american
	trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_cm_years_anglophone_cm_american } var:te_cm_years_anglophone_cm_american >= te_cm_years_tier2 }
}

# Any scope. anglo_canadian is free for the anglophone merge.
te_cmg_anglophone_anglo_canadian_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. anglo_canadian (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the anglophone merge now.

	var:te_cm_ok_anglophone_anglo_canadian ?= 1
	te_cmg_anglophone_anglo_canadian_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_anglophone_anglo_canadian ?= 1 }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. australian is free for the anglophone merge.
te_cmg_anglophone_australian_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. australian (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the anglophone merge now.
te_cmg_anglophone_australian_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_anglophone_australian ?= 1
	te_cmg_anglophone_australian_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_anglophone_australian ?= 1 }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. scottish is free for the anglophone merge.
te_cmg_anglophone_scottish_available = {
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_in_scottish ?= 11 }
}

# Country scope. scottish (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the anglophone merge now.
te_cmg_anglophone_scottish_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_anglophone_scottish ?= 1
	te_cmg_anglophone_scottish_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_anglophone_scottish ?= 1 }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. dixie is free for the anglophone merge.
te_cmg_anglophone_dixie_available = {
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_in_dixie ?= 12 }
}

# Country scope. dixie (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the anglophone merge now.
te_cmg_anglophone_dixie_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_anglophone_dixie ?= 1
	te_cmg_anglophone_dixie_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_anglophone_dixie ?= 1 }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. afro_american is free for the anglophone merge.
te_cmg_anglophone_afro_american_available = {
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_in_afro_american ?= 12 }
}

# Country scope. afro_american (tier 1b) passes its gates and can join the anglophone merge now.
te_cmg_anglophone_afro_american_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_anglophone_afro_american ?= 1
	te_cmg_anglophone_afro_american_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_anglophone_afro_american ?= 1 }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 2 }
	has_variable = te_cm_years_anglophone_afro_american
	trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_cm_years_anglophone_afro_american } var:te_cm_years_anglophone_afro_american >= te_cm_years_tier2 }
}

# Any scope. Is the yearly census of the anglophone merge worth running? An idle merge with a
# candidate; or a running or complete one whose starter is alive and which still has a
# part that has neither switched nor left the world (a complete merge keeps its census so
# late parts can join). An absorb merge's result never switches, so it doesn't count.
te_cmg_anglophone_census_wanted = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_anglophone ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_anglophone ?= 2 }
			any_country = { te_cmg_anglophone_is_candidate = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_anglophone ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_anglophone ?= 2
			}
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_anglophone
			global_var:te_cm_starter_anglophone = { is_country_alive = yes }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_british }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:british value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_yankee }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:yankee value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_american }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:cm_american value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_anglo_canadian }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:anglo_canadian value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_australian }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:australian value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_scottish }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:scottish value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_dixie }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:dixie value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_afro_american }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:afro_american value > 0 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. peruvian (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the andean merge now.
te_cmg_andean_peruvian_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_andean_peruvian ?= 1
	te_cmg_andean_peruvian_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_andean_peruvian ?= 1 }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. bolivian is free for the andean merge.
te_cmg_andean_bolivian_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. bolivian (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the andean merge now.
te_cmg_andean_bolivian_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_andean_bolivian ?= 1
	te_cmg_andean_bolivian_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_andean_bolivian ?= 1 }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. Is the yearly census of the andean merge worth running? An idle merge with a
# candidate; or a running or complete one whose starter is alive and which still has a
# part that has neither switched nor left the world (a complete merge keeps its census so
# late parts can join). An absorb merge's result never switches, so it doesn't count.
te_cmg_andean_census_wanted = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_andean ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_andean ?= 2 }
			any_country = { te_cmg_andean_is_candidate = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_andean ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_andean ?= 2
			}
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_andean
			global_var:te_cm_starter_andean = { is_country_alive = yes }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_north_andean }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:north_andean value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_south_andean }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:south_andean value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_peruvian }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:peruvian value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bolivian }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:bolivian value > 0 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# ---- gran_colombian (colombian, venezuelan, ecuadorian) ----

# Country scope. Can this country start the gran_colombian merge? The system is on, a core culture is
# primary, the technology of the highest core tier is known, and the merge is not complete.
te_cmg_gran_colombian_is_candidate = {
	te_cm_system_enabled = yes
	OR = {
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:colombian
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:venezuelan
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:ecuadorian
	}
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_state_gran_colombian ?= 2 }
}

# Country scope. Every core slot has a passing, available alternative.
te_cmg_gran_colombian_core_ok = {
	var:te_cm_ok_gran_colombian_colombian ?= 1
	te_cmg_gran_colombian_colombian_available = yes
	var:te_cm_ok_gran_colombian_venezuelan ?= 1
	te_cmg_gran_colombian_venezuelan_available = yes
	var:te_cm_ok_gran_colombian_ecuadorian ?= 1
	te_cmg_gran_colombian_ecuadorian_available = yes
}

# Any scope. colombian is free for the gran_colombian merge.
te_cmg_gran_colombian_colombian_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. colombian (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the gran_colombian merge now.
te_cmg_gran_colombian_colombian_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_gran_colombian_colombian ?= 1
	te_cmg_gran_colombian_colombian_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_gran_colombian_colombian ?= 1 }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. venezuelan is free for the gran_colombian merge.
te_cmg_gran_colombian_venezuelan_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. venezuelan (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the gran_colombian merge now.
te_cmg_gran_colombian_venezuelan_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_gran_colombian_venezuelan ?= 1
	te_cmg_gran_colombian_venezuelan_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_gran_colombian_venezuelan ?= 1 }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. ecuadorian is free for the gran_colombian merge.
te_cmg_gran_colombian_ecuadorian_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. ecuadorian (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the gran_colombian merge now.
te_cmg_gran_colombian_ecuadorian_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_gran_colombian_ecuadorian ?= 1
	te_cmg_gran_colombian_ecuadorian_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_gran_colombian_ecuadorian ?= 1 }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. Is the yearly census of the gran_colombian merge worth running? An idle merge with a
# candidate; or a running or complete one whose starter is alive and which still has a
# part that has neither switched nor left the world (a complete merge keeps its census so
# late parts can join). An absorb merge's result never switches, so it doesn't count.
te_cmg_gran_colombian_census_wanted = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_gran_colombian ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_gran_colombian ?= 2 }
			any_country = { te_cmg_gran_colombian_is_candidate = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_gran_colombian ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_gran_colombian ?= 2
			}
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_gran_colombian
			global_var:te_cm_starter_gran_colombian = { is_country_alive = yes }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_colombian }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:colombian value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_venezuelan }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:venezuelan value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_ecuadorian }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:ecuadorian value > 0 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

	trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_cm_years_arab_sudanese } var:te_cm_years_arab_sudanese >= te_cm_years_tier2 }

	trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_cm_years_arab_bidan } var:te_cm_years_arab_bidan >= te_cm_years_tier2 }

# late parts can join). An absorb merge's result never switches, so it doesn't count.

			NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_arab ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_arab ?= 2 }

		}

				global_var:te_cm_state_arab ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_arab ?= 2
			}
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_arab
			global_var:te_cm_starter_arab = { is_country_alive = yes }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_maghrebi }

				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_misri }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:misri value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_mashriqi }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:mashriqi value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bedouin }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:bedouin value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_yemenite }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:yemenite value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_sudanese }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:sudanese value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_haratin }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:haratin value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bidan }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:bidan value > 0 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

te_cmg_persian_persian_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_persian_persian ?= 1
	te_cmg_persian_persian_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_persian_persian ?= 1 }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. luri is free for the persian merge.
te_cmg_persian_luri_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. luri (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the persian merge now.
te_cmg_persian_luri_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_persian_luri ?= 1
	te_cmg_persian_luri_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_persian_luri ?= 1 }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. tajik is free for the persian merge.
te_cmg_persian_tajik_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. tajik (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the persian merge now.
te_cmg_persian_tajik_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_persian_tajik ?= 1
	te_cmg_persian_tajik_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_persian_tajik ?= 1 }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. hazara is free for the persian merge.
te_cmg_persian_hazara_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. hazara (tier 1b) passes its gates and can join the persian merge now.
te_cmg_persian_hazara_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_persian_hazara ?= 1
	te_cmg_persian_hazara_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_persian_hazara ?= 1 }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 2 }
	has_variable = te_cm_years_persian_hazara
	trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_cm_years_persian_hazara } var:te_cm_years_persian_hazara >= te_cm_years_tier2 }
}

# Any scope. Is the yearly census of the persian merge worth running? An idle merge with a
# candidate; or a running or complete one whose starter is alive and which still has a
# part that has neither switched nor left the world (a complete merge keeps its census so
# late parts can join). An absorb merge's result never switches, so it doesn't count.
te_cmg_persian_census_wanted = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_persian ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_persian ?= 2 }
			any_country = { te_cmg_persian_is_candidate = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_persian ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_persian ?= 2
			}
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_persian
			global_var:te_cm_starter_persian = { is_country_alive = yes }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_luri }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:luri value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_tajik }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:tajik value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_hazara }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:hazara value > 0 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# ---- oghuz_turkic (turkish, azerbaijani) ----

# Country scope. Can this country start the oghuz_turkic merge? The system is on, a core culture is
# primary, the technology of the highest core tier is known, and the merge is not complete.
te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_is_candidate = {
	te_cm_system_enabled = yes
	OR = {
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:turkish
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:azerbaijani
	}
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_state_oghuz_turkic ?= 2 }
}

# Country scope. Every core slot has a passing, available alternative.
te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_core_ok = {
	var:te_cm_ok_oghuz_turkic_turkish ?= 1
	te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_turkish_available = yes
	var:te_cm_ok_oghuz_turkic_azerbaijani ?= 1
	te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_azerbaijani_available = yes
}

te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_turkish_available = {
	always = yes
}

	te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_turkish_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_oghuz_turkic_turkish ?= 1 }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. azerbaijani is free for the oghuz_turkic merge.

	always = yes
}

# Country scope. azerbaijani (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the oghuz_turkic merge now.

	te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_azerbaijani_available = yes

	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. turkmen is free for the oghuz_turkic merge.

	always = yes
}

# Country scope. turkmen (tier 1b) passes its gates and can join the oghuz_turkic merge now.
te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_turkmen_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_oghuz_turkic_turkmen ?= 1
	te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_turkmen_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_oghuz_turkic_turkmen ?= 1 }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 2 }
	has_variable = te_cm_years_oghuz_turkic_turkmen
	trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_cm_years_oghuz_turkic_turkmen } var:te_cm_years_oghuz_turkic_turkmen >= te_cm_years_tier2 }
}

# Any scope. Is the yearly census of the oghuz_turkic merge worth running? An idle merge with a
# candidate; or a running or complete one whose starter is alive and which still has a
# part that has neither switched nor left the world (a complete merge keeps its census so
# late parts can join). An absorb merge's result never switches, so it doesn't count.
te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_census_wanted = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_oghuz_turkic ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_oghuz_turkic ?= 2 }
			any_country = { te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_is_candidate = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_oghuz_turkic ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_oghuz_turkic ?= 2
			}
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_oghuz_turkic
			global_var:te_cm_starter_oghuz_turkic = { is_country_alive = yes }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_turkish }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:turkish value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_azerbaijani }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:azerbaijani value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_turkmen }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:turkmen value > 0 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bornean }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:bornean value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_balinese }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:balinese value > 0 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# ---- filipino (filipino, visayan, tagalog, ilocano) ----

# Country scope. Can this country start the filipino merge? The system is on, a core culture is
# primary, the technology of the highest core tier is known, and the merge is not complete.
te_cmg_filipino_is_candidate = {
	te_cm_system_enabled = yes
	OR = {
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:filipino
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:visayan
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:tagalog
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:ilocano
	}
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_state_filipino ?= 2 }
}

# Country scope. Every core slot has a passing, available alternative.
te_cmg_filipino_core_ok = {
	var:te_cm_ok_filipino_filipino ?= 1
	te_cmg_filipino_filipino_available = yes
	var:te_cm_ok_filipino_visayan ?= 1
	te_cmg_filipino_visayan_available = yes
	var:te_cm_ok_filipino_tagalog ?= 1
	te_cmg_filipino_tagalog_available = yes
	var:te_cm_ok_filipino_ilocano ?= 1
	te_cmg_filipino_ilocano_available = yes
}

# Any scope. filipino is free for the filipino merge.
te_cmg_filipino_filipino_available = {
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_in_filipino ?= 31 }
}

# Country scope. filipino (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the filipino merge now.
te_cmg_filipino_filipino_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_filipino_filipino ?= 1
	te_cmg_filipino_filipino_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_filipino_filipino ?= 1 }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. visayan is free for the filipino merge.
te_cmg_filipino_visayan_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. visayan (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the filipino merge now.
te_cmg_filipino_visayan_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_filipino_visayan ?= 1
	te_cmg_filipino_visayan_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_filipino_visayan ?= 1 }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. tagalog is free for the filipino merge.
te_cmg_filipino_tagalog_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. tagalog (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the filipino merge now.
te_cmg_filipino_tagalog_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_filipino_tagalog ?= 1
	te_cmg_filipino_tagalog_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_filipino_tagalog ?= 1 }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. ilocano is free for the filipino merge.
te_cmg_filipino_ilocano_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. ilocano (tier 1) passes its gates and can join the filipino merge now.
te_cmg_filipino_ilocano_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_filipino_ilocano ?= 1
	te_cmg_filipino_ilocano_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_filipino_ilocano ?= 1 }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. Is the yearly census of the filipino merge worth running? An idle merge with a
# candidate; or a running or complete one whose starter is alive and which still has a
# part that has neither switched nor left the world (a complete merge keeps its census so
# late parts can join). An absorb merge's result never switches, so it doesn't count.
te_cmg_filipino_census_wanted = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_filipino ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_filipino ?= 2 }
			any_country = { te_cmg_filipino_is_candidate = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_filipino ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_filipino ?= 2
			}
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_filipino
			global_var:te_cm_starter_filipino = { is_country_alive = yes }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_visayan }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:visayan value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_tagalog }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:tagalog value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_ilocano }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:ilocano value > 0 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Can this country start the latin merge? The system is on, a core culture is

		country_has_primary_culture = cu:cm_italian

	var:te_cm_ok_latin_french ?= 1
	te_cmg_latin_french_available = yes
	var:te_cm_ok_latin_cm_italian ?= 1
	te_cmg_latin_cm_italian_available = yes

	te_cmg_latin_spanish_available = yes
	var:te_cm_ok_latin_portuguese ?= 1
	te_cmg_latin_portuguese_available = yes

# Any scope. Is the yearly census of the latin merge worth running? An idle merge with a
# candidate; or a running or complete one whose starter is alive and which still has a
# part that has neither switched nor left the world (a complete merge keeps its census so
# late parts can join). An absorb merge's result never switches, so it doesn't count.
te_cmg_latin_census_wanted = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_latin ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_latin ?= 2 }
			any_country = { te_cmg_latin_is_candidate = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_latin ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_latin ?= 2
			}
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_latin
			global_var:te_cm_starter_latin = { is_country_alive = yes }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_french }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:french value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_italian }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:cm_italian value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_spanish }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:spanish value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_portuguese }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:portuguese value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_romanian }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:romanian value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_platinean }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:platinean value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_argentine }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:argentine value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_uruguayan }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:uruguayan value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_chilean }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:chilean value > 0 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

	te_cmg_pan_slavic_polish_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_slavic_polish ?= 1 }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 1 }
}

# Any scope. slovene is free for the pan_slavic merge.
te_cmg_pan_slavic_slovene_available = {
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_in_slovene ?= 5 }
}

# Country scope. slovene (tier 2) passes its gates and can join the pan_slavic merge now.
te_cmg_pan_slavic_slovene_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_pan_slavic_slovene ?= 1
	te_cmg_pan_slavic_slovene_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_slavic_slovene ?= 1 }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 3 }
	has_variable = te_cm_years_pan_slavic_slovene
	trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_cm_years_pan_slavic_slovene } var:te_cm_years_pan_slavic_slovene >= te_cm_years_tier3 }
}

# Any scope. bulgarian is free for the pan_slavic merge.
te_cmg_pan_slavic_bulgarian_available = {
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_in_bulgarian ?= 5 }
}

# Country scope. bulgarian (tier 2) passes its gates and can join the pan_slavic merge now.
te_cmg_pan_slavic_bulgarian_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_pan_slavic_bulgarian ?= 1
	te_cmg_pan_slavic_bulgarian_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_slavic_bulgarian ?= 1 }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 3 }
	has_variable = te_cm_years_pan_slavic_bulgarian
	trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_cm_years_pan_slavic_bulgarian } var:te_cm_years_pan_slavic_bulgarian >= te_cm_years_tier3 }
}

# Any scope. Is the yearly census of the pan_slavic merge worth running? An idle merge with a
# candidate; or a running or complete one whose starter is alive and which still has a
# part that has neither switched nor left the world (a complete merge keeps its census so
# late parts can join). An absorb merge's result never switches, so it doesn't count.
te_cmg_pan_slavic_census_wanted = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_pan_slavic ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_pan_slavic ?= 2 }
			any_country = { te_cmg_pan_slavic_is_candidate = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_pan_slavic ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_pan_slavic ?= 2
			}
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_pan_slavic
			global_var:te_cm_starter_pan_slavic = { is_country_alive = yes }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_east_slavic }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:cm_east_slavic value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_czechoslovak }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:cm_czechoslovak value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_yugoslav }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:cm_yugoslav value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_polish }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:polish value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_slovene }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:slovene value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bulgarian }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:bulgarian value > 0 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# ---- pan_turkic (cm_oghuz_turkic, uzbek, kazak, tatar, kirgiz) ----

# Country scope. Can this country start the pan_turkic merge? The system is on, a core culture is
# primary, the technology of the highest core tier is known, and the merge is not complete.
te_cmg_pan_turkic_is_candidate = {
	te_cm_system_enabled = yes
	OR = {
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:cm_oghuz_turkic
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:uzbek
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:kazak
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:tatar
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:kirgiz
	}
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 3 }
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_state_pan_turkic ?= 2 }
}

# Country scope. Every core slot has a passing, available alternative.
te_cmg_pan_turkic_core_ok = {
	var:te_cm_ok_pan_turkic_cm_oghuz_turkic ?= 1
	te_cmg_pan_turkic_cm_oghuz_turkic_available = yes
	var:te_cm_ok_pan_turkic_uzbek ?= 1
	te_cmg_pan_turkic_uzbek_available = yes
	var:te_cm_ok_pan_turkic_kazak ?= 1
	te_cmg_pan_turkic_kazak_available = yes
	var:te_cm_ok_pan_turkic_tatar ?= 1
	te_cmg_pan_turkic_tatar_available = yes
	var:te_cm_ok_pan_turkic_kirgiz ?= 1
	te_cmg_pan_turkic_kirgiz_available = yes
}

# Any scope. cm_oghuz_turkic is free for the pan_turkic merge.
te_cmg_pan_turkic_cm_oghuz_turkic_available = {
	global_var:te_cm_state_oghuz_turkic ?= 2
}

# Country scope. cm_oghuz_turkic (tier 2) passes its gates and can join the pan_turkic merge now.
te_cmg_pan_turkic_cm_oghuz_turkic_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_pan_turkic_cm_oghuz_turkic ?= 1
	te_cmg_pan_turkic_cm_oghuz_turkic_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_pan_turkic_cm_oghuz_turkic ?= 1 }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 3 }
	has_variable = te_cm_years_pan_turkic_cm_oghuz_turkic
	trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_cm_years_pan_turkic_cm_oghuz_turkic } var:te_cm_years_pan_turkic_cm_oghuz_turkic >= te_cm_years_tier3 }
}

			any_country = { te_cmg_pan_turkic_is_candidate = yes }

				global_var:te_cm_state_pan_turkic ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_pan_turkic ?= 2
			}
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_pan_turkic
			global_var:te_cm_starter_pan_turkic = { is_country_alive = yes }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_oghuz_turkic }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:cm_oghuz_turkic value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_uzbek }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:uzbek value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_kazak }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:kazak value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_tatar }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:tatar value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_kirgiz }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:kirgiz value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bashkir }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:bashkir value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_crimean_tatar }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:crimean_tatar value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_caucasian_turk }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:caucasian_turk value > 0 } }
				}

}

# Country scope. lacustrine_bantu (tier 2) passes its gates and can join the east_african merge now.
te_cmg_east_african_lacustrine_bantu_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_east_african_lacustrine_bantu ?= 1
	te_cmg_east_african_lacustrine_bantu_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_east_african_lacustrine_bantu ?= 1 }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 3 }
	has_variable = te_cm_years_east_african_lacustrine_bantu
	trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_cm_years_east_african_lacustrine_bantu } var:te_cm_years_east_african_lacustrine_bantu >= te_cm_years_tier3 }
}

# Any scope. kikuyu is free for the east_african merge.
te_cmg_east_african_kikuyu_available = {
	always = yes
}

# Country scope. kikuyu (tier 2) passes its gates and can join the east_african merge now.
te_cmg_east_african_kikuyu_can_join = {
	var:te_cm_ok_east_african_kikuyu ?= 1
	te_cmg_east_african_kikuyu_available = yes
	NOT = { global_var:te_cm_joined_east_african_kikuyu ?= 1 }
	te_cm_tier_tech = { TIER = 3 }
	has_variable = te_cm_years_east_african_kikuyu
	trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = te_cm_years_east_african_kikuyu } var:te_cm_years_east_african_kikuyu >= te_cm_years_tier3 }
}

# Any scope. Is the yearly census of the east_african merge worth running? An idle merge with a
# candidate; or a running or complete one whose starter is alive and which still has a
# part that has neither switched nor left the world (a complete merge keeps its census so
# late parts can join). An absorb merge's result never switches, so it doesn't count.
te_cmg_east_african_census_wanted = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_east_african ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_east_african ?= 2 }
			any_country = { te_cmg_east_african_is_candidate = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_east_african ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_east_african ?= 2
			}
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_east_african
			global_var:te_cm_starter_east_african = { is_country_alive = yes }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_swahili }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:swahili value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_nyamwezi }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:nyamwezi value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_sukuma }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:sukuma value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_yao }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:yao value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_makua }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:makua value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_lacustrine_bantu }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:lacustrine_bantu value > 0 } }
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_kikuyu }
					any_country = { culture_percent_country = { target = cu:kikuyu value > 0 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
